title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Measure of the Unrecovered Guaranty Loss on a Liquidated Loan
content:
For entitlement on a liquidated VA Home Loan Guaranty loan, the guaranty loss VA has not recovered on the loan is measured from the Home Loan Guaranty Debt that arose from that loan, as the veteran's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records show it (its status and current balance), together with the loan's own money transactions (its funding fee charge entries, its funding fee refund entries and its guaranty claim entries) and the loan record's funding fee exemption.

## The measure

1. Where that home loan guaranty debt is active or under a repayment plan, the loan record shows the veteran exempt from the funding fee and the loan carries a funding fee refund entry, the unrecovered loss is the debt's balance less the part of the funding fees charged on the loan that was not paid out in refunds, never less than zero. The part not paid out is the sum of the funding fee charge entries less the sum of the funding fee refund entries, never less than zero.
2. Where the debt was closed by a waiver or a compromise and a guaranty claim was paid on the loan, the unrecovered loss is the whole guaranty claim paid on the loan.
3. Otherwise the unrecovered loss is the debt's balance.

## Truth table for the first measure

| Debt from the loan active or under a repayment plan | Loan record shows the veteran exempt | Loan carries a funding fee refund entry | Measure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Yes | Yes | No | 3, the debt's balance |
| Yes | No | Yes | 3, the debt's balance |
| Yes | No | No | 3, the debt's balance |

| Debt closed by a waiver or a compromise | Guaranty claim paid on the loan | Measure |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 2, the whole claim paid |
| Yes | No | 3 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Debt under a repayment plan, balance 20,000.00; loan shown exempt; funding fee charges of 4,650.00 and refund entries of 3,800.00. Part not paid out: 4,650.00 less 3,800.00, or 850.00. Unrecovered loss: 20,000.00 less 850.00, or 19,150.00.
- Same facts, refund entries of 4,650.00. Part not paid out: 0.00. Unrecovered loss: 20,000.00.
- Debt closed by a compromise with a balance of 0.00; guaranty claim of 42,300.00 paid on the loan. Unrecovered loss: 42,300.00.
- Debt in active collection, balance 12,000.00; loan record does not show the veteran exempt. Unrecovered loss: 12,000.00.
